rows.en: All right… We're not losing to Chief Kitakura's Security Team!!
Hee hee… Please go easy on us, won't you, Officer Soga?
Whoa… That's some impressive staging for an exercise. Pretty realistic, isn't it!
That's strange… I didn't hear anything about this…
…!? Something's not right here!
What's this!? Don't tell me… it's a real enemy?
Grandfather!!
Good work, Captain Kiriyama! And you too, Chief Kitakura…
I was stunned that we'd be attacked by the enemy in the middle of an exercise.
Mm… Above all, we're glad Dr. Yuri is safe.
Well, well… At this rate, it seems I truly have no time to lose myself in space development, eh?

In fact, we've discussed it with the doctor…

Dr. Yuri will have free use of every laboratory and will take charge of developing the new weapons we need for our defense operations.
Oh… That's amazing, Captain. With the doctor on our side, we're unbeatable.
In time, we should be able to welcome many experts active in every specialized field and develop the most powerful weapons there are.
Mm… I want you all to cooperate as well.
Captain Kiriyama, Chief Kitakura! I'm counting on you both from here on!
Sir!
Yes, sir!!

So…

this young man, Goro Watari, fought this Itsutsu-whatever from the Neo-Human Empire?
Yes…
And… you're telling me you ran back here without even fighting?

Phew… Well, it may be a natural response for a woman…

but you're not like ordinary women, are you… Anyway, I'm worried about that young man. Let's split up and look for him.
No leads… How about you? Find anything?

No, nothing here either…

But I just can't stop thinking about it. That there must be something around here…
Is that the result of your data collection?

No…

It isn't certain, but if I had to say… I think so from a feeling close to what's called "women's intuition."

…………

Women's intuition, huh… Is that Japanese culture rubbing off on you too? Sounds fishy… Hey, [HERO4]?
What is it?
…Since we came down to Earth, you've… how should I put it… changed, haven't you?

Have I?

Could it be the effect of distortion from gravitational fluctuations and faint plasma from the ionosphere?
…Keep searching for the enemy!

…!?

It's a mutant from the Neo-Human Empire!
[HERO4]! From now on, for enemy searches, I'm counting on data retrieval plus women's intuition!
Roger! Adding it to my thought program.
Itsutsu Banbara! Where's the young man who fought you?
That man is dead! I sent him to hell myself! And I'll have you follow him soon enough!
…!? He's dead?
What a pain… Turns out I'd left it here after all. I never took it out with me in the first place.
Ah-ah-ah…
Okay, so did something happen? Calm down and tell me.

O-okay…

So, um… Goro… had five faces, and the Neo-Humans… it's terrible…!
Phew… Look, the one who's in a terrible state is you! Are you okay?
Y-yeah…
All right… Then let's go back to where you were before… okay?

So that means…

this Goro guy didn't actually have five faces? Thought so… Man, that scared me.
But I have to find out what happened to Goro…
Against the Neo-Human Empire?
Th-there it is!!
Are you Itsutsu Banbara!? Where's Goro… where is he?
No way!? Goro is?
Who's dead, you say?
Hm… How are you still alive!?

Just as there is an evil mutant Neo-Human Empire, there is also a mutant Boys' League of justice!

They saved me, and I was reborn as a mutant of justice! Here I go, Goriki Shorai!
Sanagiman, who protects the world from the ambitions of the Neo-Human Empire!
Curse you, Sanagiman! I'll show you the terror of the Neo-Human Empire!
Chesto!
Now is the time to grow! Here I go, Choriki Shorai!
Warrior of freedom, [VAR6]!
Heh heh heh heh…
Is that… Kamen Rider!?
Is that… Kamen Rider!?
Is that… Kamen Rider!?
Mr. Hongo!!
Mr. Hongo!!
You're late, Hongo!!
You're late, Hongo!!
Mr. Hongo!!
Mr. Hongo!!
Oh… So you're the one who saved [HERO4]? My, that must've been rough…
Oh… So you're the one who saved [HERO4]? My, that must've been rough…
Let me thank you as well…
About [HERO4]… I'm really sorry for the trouble.
Anyway… we've got one more comrade! That's cause for celebration! Right, Takeshi?

…!?

What? This feeling…!?

Hey, what's wrong? Something bothering you… Goro?

What's with him? What on earth has gotten into him?
Ba-ra, barabarabara, Banbaaa!
Who's there!?
Emperor Banba of the Neo-Human Empire!
Emperor Banba!?
